title: Pauli Contextuality Lab: Unified Lean 4.35.0 Formalization of Spectral Bounds, Disjoint Mermin Configurations, and Sequential Contextuality Evidence
peer_review_status: Consolidated research preprint suite (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 & cross-platform CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 / Mathlib v4.35.0 (160 explicit #print axioms + exhaustive 2,206-theorem Lean.collectAxioms audit across HoggarBound, ContextualityTensor, Evidence, PauliContextualityLab; 0 Batteries linter errors; 12 headline targets verified across 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in Ubuntu 24.04 CI)

core_result: Consolidates the four archived Pauli/Mermin contextuality repositories (hoggar-bound, hoggar-bound-lab, contextuality-tensor-lab, contextuality-evidence-lab) into one unified Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 monorepo meeting Build Standard v1.1.0 (100.0%, 68/68 checks, Core 30/30) with a single pinned Lean 4.35.0 + Mathlib v4.35.0 workspace, deduplicated third-party stack, isolated monorepo stack runner (scripts/run_track_stack.py), searchable interactive 24-node / 140-declaration Lean Blueprint (/blueprint/) with direct GitHub #L source links and transitive dependency-cone highlighting, interactive Track 1-3 web explorers with clickable GitHub #L theorem links and unified Hub/Blueprint navigation, zero-overflow Tectonic PDFs (all 4 Pauli PDFs 0 overfull hboxes >= 5pt, clickable ORCID/email on p.1, 100% synced consolidated paths), and 3-OS + 10-engine zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan + zero-bugbear Python + gitleaks-clean CI (run 45508420303). Track 1 proves the universal spectral floor, Kramers floor, 5-way saturation equivalences, exact degrees (75, 480, 2016, 729344), the infinite non-closed pure-CCZ determinant family |Psi_{3m}>, unconditional N=4..5 bounds d(W(7,2))>=1455 and d(Q+(9,2))>=6444, exact four-qubit C3 binary completion optima (368 vs 344, gap 24), and Jonah's Conjecture E across all 9 vertex cases for every N>=4 (including CarrierFamily Theorem 17). Track 2 proves exact arbitrary-k disjoint-copy formulas d_k=(7^k-5^k)/2 (squares) and (6^k-4^k)/2 (pentagrams) addressing Muller & Saniga (arXiv:2609.19862v1 Sec. 6). Track 3 proves finite adaptive-tree sequential evidence bounds and a sharp setting-bias attack on the Peres-Mermin square. Live Ubuntu CI run 45508420294 built VerifyAll (0 warnings), audited 160 explicit #print axioms and all 2,206 theorems strictly within standard axioms, and verified all 12 cross-track comparator targets across all 6 independent kernels (lean-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron, lean-default) with Sigstore/Rekor attestation (logIndex 4088299017; Release v2.6.0 Rekor logIndex 4088072599).
verification_boundary: 160 explicit headline declarations plus an exhaustive 2,206-theorem Lean.collectAxioms audit in VerifyAll.lean (zero sorry, zero native_decide, zero warnings, strictly within [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]) and 12 cross-track Challenge/Solution targets are machine-checked in Lean 4.35.0 across 6 independent kernels in CI; 46 pytest suites (property, negative, 6-mutant killing, 300-payload fuzz, live C3/Blueprint/explorer/monorepo integrity), 2 Node web-model tests, 7 track exact verifiers, and 10 zero-warning C11 ASan/UBSan engines pass across Linux/macOS/Windows CI. Finite C censuses (540.3M N=9 forms, 42-orbit W(5,2) census), Moonlab/QGTL/QRNG simulations, and exploratory floating-point scripts are explicitly separated from Lean kernel proofs (see CLAIMS.md, LIMITATIONS.md, and docs/statement-fidelity.md). No external peer review, hardware experiment, or external DOI is claimed.
